FIFA World Cup 2026: Integrity of tournament questioned over Balogun suspension

The integrity of the FIFA World Cup 2026 has been questioned after US President Donald Trump intervened in the suspension of Nigerian player Folarin Balogun, with FIFA's head Gianni Infantino defending the organization's judicial bodies. The controversy surrounds a red card given to Balogun during a match, and Trump's request for a review of the decision. FIFA has since lifted the suspension, but the incident has raised concerns about the independence of the organization's disciplinary processes.
